## The gap Slack can't fill

Slack is where your team communicates. But communication isn't process.

When someone asks "can you approve this?" in Slack, there's no owner, no deadline, no escalation. If the message gets buried in a busy channel, the work doesn't happen. Slack can't track whether a request was completed or who's responsible.

**What Slack handles:**

- Real-time messaging
- Channel-based conversations
- File sharing and search
- Video calls and huddles

**What falls through the cracks:**

- Request tracking with ownership and deadlines
- Approval workflows with audit trails
- SLA enforcement and automatic escalation
- Process visibility across the organization
- Completion tracking and performance metrics

Slack is where teams talk. Tallyfy is where work gets tracked. The integration bridges conversation to action.

## Native integration available

<Aside type="tip" title="Integration status">
Tallyfy has a native Slack integration in the [Slack App Directory](https://slack.com/apps/AF15436JJ-tallyfy).
</Aside>

### What you can do

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Create task | Turn any Slack message into a tracked Tallyfy task |
| Launch process | Start a Tallyfy workflow from a Slack conversation |
| Create document | Start a new Tallyfy document template from a Slack message |
| Settings | Connect your Tallyfy account or switch organizations with `/tallyfy-config` |

The app works in one direction, from Slack into Tallyfy. It doesn't post Tallyfy alerts in Slack, and you can't view or update tasks from Slack. To see what's assigned to you or what's changed, check your [notifications in Tallyfy](/products/pro/tracking-and-tasks/how-can-i-view-notifications-in-tallyfy/).

### Installation

1. Find the Tallyfy app in the [Slack App Directory](https://slack.com/apps/AF15436JJ-tallyfy) or on the [Tallyfy integrations page](https://tallyfy.com/integrations/)
2. Click **Add to Slack**
3. Choose your workspace and authorize permissions
4. Connect your Tallyfy account

Everyone else in your Slack workspace connects their own Tallyfy account. They type `/tallyfy-config` and click **Connect to Tallyfy**.

### Using the integration

<lite-vimeo videoid="348671293"></lite-vimeo>

You can start **Create Task**, **Launch Process** and **Create Document** from a message's **More actions** menu (three dots). You can also type `/` in any message box and pick one from the list.

**Create a task from a message:**
1. Hover over any Slack message
2. Click the **More actions** menu (three dots)
3. Select **Create Task**
4. Type a task name, pick an assignee and check the deadline
5. Click **Submit**

The message text becomes the task's description. The deadline starts as `tomorrow`, and you can type another one in everyday words, such as `next Friday 5pm`.

**Launch a process:**
1. Type `/` in any message box and select **Launch Process**
2. Start typing a template's name, select it and click **Select**
3. Click **Continue** under the template Tallyfy shows you
4. Name the process, fill out the [kick-off form](/products/pro/launching/triggers/kick-off-forms/) and click **Launch**

**Create a document:**
1. Hover over any Slack message and click **More actions**
2. Select **Create Document**
3. Type a document name and click **Submit**

The message text becomes the description of a new [document template](/products/pro/documenting/documents/) in Tallyfy.

**Connect your account or switch organizations:**
1. Type `/tallyfy-config` in any channel
2. Click **Connect to Tallyfy** if you haven't connected yet
3. Once you're connected, click **Select Organization** to choose which Tallyfy organization Slack uses

## Troubleshooting

If the integration isn't working:

- Verify your Tallyfy account has permission to create tasks and launch processes
- Check that the Tallyfy app is properly authorized in your Slack workspace
- If the app asks you to upgrade when you launch a process, your organization's Tallyfy plan doesn't allow launching from Slack. The message links to your plan page
- Contact [Tallyfy support](/products/pro/miscellaneous/support/how-can-i-contact-tallyfys-support-team/) if issues persist

## Get started

Install the [Tallyfy Slack app](https://slack.com/apps/AF15436JJ-tallyfy) to start turning conversations into tracked workflows.
